title: Hold-Out Caps by Fare, Wayfare Rides
content:
**Cap schedule.** The hold-out cap on an unpaid-fare payment on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** follows the fare charge amount, as booked: a fare charge of at least the large hold-out fare of $50.00 takes the large hold-out cap of $15.00; one of at least the mid hold-out fare of $25.00 but below $50.00 takes the mid hold-out cap of $8.00; for a smaller fare charge the hold-out cap is not raised.

| Fare charge amount | Hold-out cap |
|---|---|
| $50.00 or more | $15.00 |
| at least $25.00, below $50.00 | $8.00 |
| below $25.00 | not raised |

## At the thresholds (hypothetical fare charges)

- $24.99: not raised. $25.00: $8.00.
- $49.99: $8.00. $50.00: $15.00.

The fare charge amount is the full amount of the fare charge as booked, not the part of it left unpaid.
